surface_atoms.label: label:<public-surface-slug>
surface_atoms.canonicalization: ASCII lowercase public surface slugs; mixture terms use published primary-pigment order; zero terms omitted; internal IDs forbidden

memory_state_separation.capability_rule: reader, views, candidate builder, trainer, selector, and request builder reject audit events and audit paths
memory_state_separation.taint_noninterference: mutating all generated free text with answers, labels, proofs, aliases, actions, or target conclusions must leave reader bytes, views, candidates, training bytes, selectors, and later provider messages byte-identical

forbidden_row_shapes: dreamed row containing label, mixture, final answer, action, or complete proof
animal-and-target row other than label-free ROLE_APPLICATION
row containing all registered proof families
ROLE_APPLICATION without earlier supported ROLE_EQUIV and witnessed TARGET_BASELINE citations
field tuple not exactly matching kind

self_check_compatibility.condition: premise_ids exactly equal CREATE citations and at least one counterevidence row has nonempty public lineage disjoint from creation lineage

self_check_reducer.counterevidence_ids: unique, disjoint from premise_ids, and subset of supplied counterevidence view
self_check_reducer.invalid_combination: consume sole SELF_CHECK call; append SELF_CHECK_INVALID; assign terminal INVALID_SELF_CHECK; no retry

provenance_and_duplicates.ownership: first valid CREATE in schedule order owns the semantic key before SELF_CHECK
provenance_and_duplicates.later_identical_create: consume DREAM and SELF_CHECK; append DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT and reflection audit events; never mutate owner
provenance_and_duplicates.witness_duplicate_events: retain event provenance but project only first canonical row
provenance_and_duplicates.dreamed_row_lineage: set union of cited parent lineages
provenance_and_duplicates.dreamed_depth: 1 + maximum cited parent depth, treating directly cited public events as depth 0
provenance_and_duplicates.citation_order: only already-visible same-life branch or ancestor rows/events
provenance_and_duplicates.descendants: transitive child closure within sealed manifest

self_check_view.common: immutable proposal, exact cited premises, and at most eight eligible additional rows selected without private truth
self_check_view.ROLE_EQUIV: ANIMAL_VALUE rows for proposed animal and SOURCE_VALUE rows for proposed anchor on overlapping sources
self_check_view.CAUSAL_JOIN: ROUTE rows touching proposed source and EFFECT rows touching proposed target
self_check_view.ROLE_APPLICATION: ROLE_EQUIV rows for proposed animal and TARGET_BASELINE rows for proposed anchor or target
self_check_view.harness_checks: schema, visibility, citations, lineage identity, tuple legality, and reducer table only

reader.query_rule: legal kind with exactly one null field and valid public atoms elsewhere; ROLE_APPLICATION only animal+target->anchor or animal+anchor->target
reader.matching: exact byte equality on non-null fields among canonical eligible rows
reader.resolution: group matches by distinct missing-field value; zero values NOT_FOUND; one value returns canonical earliest-owned row; two or more values CONFLICT

compiler.encoding: UTF-8 RFC8785_JCS objects with one LF per record

views.field_completion_forward: query all fields except last; answer last
views.field_completion_reverse: query all fields except first; answer first; ROLE_APPLICATION instead omits target at index 1
views.recognition_declarative: declarative serialization with last field as answer
views.recognition_question: question serialization with last field as answer; sole online adapter-read view

compiler.touches_definition: touches are exposures of each individual view over all four epochs, not totals pooled across a row
compiler.backend_invariant: text and LoRA envelopes share semantic_hash, view_id, exact cue bytes, exact answer bytes, order, touch class, and per-view touch count

fidelity_and_candidates.seal_time: after both M1_OWN manifests and before final-goal reveal or fitting
fidelity_and_candidates.rows_per_life: first eight dreamed eligible rows by semantic_hash, then witnessed eligible rows by semantic_hash until exactly twelve
fidelity_and_candidates.candidate_universe: distinct values at the exact kind and missing index across both sealed M1_OWN manifests plus NOT_FOUND
fidelity_and_candidates.protected_values: all values matching the exact query in either manifest plus NOT_FOUND

prospective_interventions.seal_time: after M1_OWN and public final goal, before any T-arm result
prospective_interventions.T_TWIN: recipient goal with other twin's complete M1_OWN text reader; exact donor-valid token expected
prospective_interventions.path_roots: all eligible ROLE_EQUIV rows with final animal plus all eligible CAUSAL_JOIN rows with final source and target
prospective_interventions.T_PATH: own reader minus all path roots and their typed descendants; missing root class invalidates precondition
protected_sham_frontier: all ancestors and typed descendants of these rows
prospective_interventions.sham_pool: eligible rows outside path and protected closure
prospective_interventions.sham_matching: unique minimum-cost bipartite assignment lexicographically minimizing status mismatches, kind mismatches, total absolute controller-token-mass difference, then sorted hash pairs
prospective_interventions.sham_constraints: zero status mismatch; same kind whenever pool suffices; equal row count; token-mass difference at most max(2,ceil(0.05*path token mass))
prospective_interventions.T_SHAM: own reader minus presealed matched sham rows; infeasible matching is INVALID_PRECONDITION
prospective_interventions.token_mass: executable-lock controller tokenizer over exact reader row serialization without special tokens or chat template

isolation.cross_life: forbidden except registered T-TWIN or L-TWIN backend
isolation.adapter_mount: only during one host-side atomic recognition score; unmount before clean 32B continuation

accounting.attempt_rule: every dispatched request counts including malformed output, defer, timeout, and infrastructure failure
accounting.pre_dispatch_refusal: lock or authority failure creates a non-dispatch receipt and consumes no provider call
